nodes.evidence_snippet: The absorption edge positions of L-Ala-Co-COF and S-py-Co-COF (Figure 1f) ... clearly indicate the presence of Co species with positive charges. Notably, negligible metallic Co-Co peaks were observed

nodes.evidence_snippet: Calculations indicated a coordination number of approximately six (CoN3O3) for the central Co atom of S-py-Co-COF ... For L-Ala-Co-COF, the coordination number is also approximately six ... Two N and four O are coordinated with the central Co atom
